reason: Exodus 39 has the phrase ten times; it is seven times only in the garments account (39:1-31), which the sentence is describing.
evidence: Sefaria Hebrew Exodus 39: 'כאשר צוה יהוה את משה' at verses 1, 5, 7, 21, 26, 29, 31, then again at 32, 42 and (as 'צוה יהוה כן עשו') 43 (https://www.sefaria.org/api/v3/texts/Exodus.39?version=hebrew)

cur: kills three thousand people — the immediate ringleaders.
new: kills about three thousand people.
reason: The Torah gives 'some three thousand' and does not call them ringleaders; the Talmud says those killed by the sword were people who worshipped the calf.
evidence: Exodus 32:28 'some three thousand of the people fell that day' (https://www.sefaria.org/api/v3/texts/Exodus.32.28); Yoma 66b: 'One who sacrificed and burned incense to the calf... was punished by the sword' (https://www.sefaria.org/api/v3/texts/Yoma.66b)

cur: a golden menorah beaten from a single talent of gold with six branches
new: a golden menorah hammered from a single piece of pure gold with six branches
reason: The talent of gold covers the menorah together with its tongs and pans (same issue as EXO-38); the Torah's point is that it is one hammered piece.
evidence: Exodus 25:36 'the whole of it a single hammered piece of pure gold' (https://www.sefaria.org/api/v3/texts/Exodus.25.31-36); 25:39 'It shall be made, with all these furnishings, out of a talent of pure gold' (https://www.sefaria.org/api/v3/texts/Exodus.25.39)
